tagline: The world's leading outdoor advertising company with digital transformation leadership
hero_kpi_rationale: Digital revenue (DOOH) now represents 36.8% of total revenue, up sharply (+4.1 points), and is the primary driver of the group's transformation, fueled by the adoption of programmatic advertising and data.

kpis.name: Digital Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue generated from digital screens (DOOH) in total revenue.
kpis.description: DOOH reached 36.8% of total revenue in H1 2024, up from 32.7% a year earlier, driven by the deployment of digital screens in premium locations.

kpis.name: Programmatic Advertising Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated via the VIOOH platform, based on real-time auctions powered by data.
kpis.description: Programmatic revenue increased by 61.8% to €59.7M, representing 9.0% of digital revenue, with 46 DSPs connected to VIOOH now active in 21 countries.

kpis.name: Organic Adjusted Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth at constant scope and exchange rates.
kpis.description: Organic growth of +13.4% in H1 2024, peaking at +15.4% in Q2, driven by digital and sectors such as tech, media, and consumer goods.
kpis.signal: Positive organic growth across all segments and geographic regions

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating margin reached €261.4M, or 14.5% of revenue (+1.8 pts vs 12.7% H1 2023), with improvements across all segments, particularly in Billboards.
kpis.signal: Improved profitability driven by operating leverage

kpis.name: Adjusted Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: The company's ability to generate cash after investments.
kpis.description: Adjusted free cash flow amounted to -€20.1M in H1 2024, a significant improvement (+€159.6M vs -€179.7M H1 2023), supported by higher self-funding capacity of €138.9M.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets, particularly for the deployment of digital screens.
kpis.description: Capex amounted to €159.0M in H1 2024, maintained at a high level to support the selective deployment strategy of digital screens in premium locations.
kpis.signal: Sustained capex to accelerate digitalization of premium sites

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €8.14B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €3.93B in the latest year

risks.title: Increased competition in digital out-of-home advertising
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicitly mentioned in the strong growth of DOOH and VIOOH, with moderate language intensity but a clear trend toward competitive technological upgrading. The 'Competition' category weighs heavily in the fast-expanding sector.

risks.title: Dependence on local outdoor advertising regulations
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly cites regulation as a constraint in France, using strong language ('rationalization in line with regulations'). The risk is stable but critical in mature markets.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of programmatic platforms
risks.score_rationale: Although not directly mentioned, the rise of programmatic DOOH (VIOOH) and management of advertising data expose JCDecaux to cyber risks. Intensity is moderate, but the trend is upward with digital expansion.

risks.title: Slowing recovery in China
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes that activity in China remains 'significantly below' pre-Covid levels, using strong language and a central position in commentary. The risk is persistent.

risks.title: Dependence on urban mobility contracts
risks.score_rationale: Urban furniture and transport contracts are central to the business model. The language is factual but repeated, indicating a high structural risk with a stable trend.

risks.title: Risks related to accelerated digitalization
risks.score_rationale: Digital transformation is a growth driver (36.8% of digital revenue), but involves heavy technology investments. Intensity is high, and the trend is upward.

risks.title: Concentration of location suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly mentioned, but implied in dependence on urban contracts. Risk is moderate, but reinforced by sector structure. Secondary position in the document.

risks.title: Reputation related to sustainability and climate commitments
risks.score_rationale: The document highlights ESG rankings and SBTi validation, indicating strong reputational exposure to environmental performance. Language is positive, but underlying risk is high.

ai_positioning.summary: JCDecaux integrates artificial intelligence through its programmatic platform VIOOH, leveraging data to optimize advertising campaigns in real time. The company positions itself as a key player in the adoption of AI in digital out-of-home advertising.
evidence: +61.8% growth in programmatic revenue via VIOOH to €59.7M
VIOOH platform is the most connected in the industry with 46 DSPs linked, active in 21 countries
Displayce (partner DSP) platform active in 80 countries
Use of data for innovative, dynamic campaigns powered by data
